message.content: LiHua has expressed very positive feedback regarding Hailey's new artisanal donuts. In the conversation recorded on July 12, 2026 (ID 0), LiHua states, "I really loved the chocolate hazelnut one! It had the perfect balance of sweetness." This indicates that the chocolate hazelnut flavor was particularly appreciated. Additionally, in another interaction on August 29, 2026 (ID 2), LiHua provides a balanced view, saying, "Honestly, I think a little less sweet makes them more enjoyable! That way, you can really taste the flavors. But a touch of sweetness is still nice!" This feedback suggests that while LiHua prefers a slightly less sweet version, he still enjoys the donuts overall. Overall, the feedback from LiHua supports Hailey's efforts to create unique and delicious artisanal donuts, showcasing his satisfaction with the product line.
